holdout_card.fact_statement: Céline Dion was one of the international musicians who performed at the 2024 Summer Olympics opening ceremony.
holdout_card.source_span: The ceremony featured musical performances by French musicians such as Gojira, Aya Nakamura, Philippe Katerine, and Juliette Armanet, and international musicians Lady Gaga and Céline Dion.

qa_variants.question: Along with Lady Gaga, which other international musician performed at the 2024 Summer Olympics opening ceremony?
qa_variants.source_span: The ceremony featured musical performances by French musicians such as Gojira, Aya Nakamura, Philippe Katerine, and Juliette Armanet, and international musicians Lady Gaga and Céline Dion.
